text:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR that swaps the old cost/latency heatmap example for a smaller, focused sample that includes the tracing-hook call. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

own: Nice, can you tag which snippets need lint + runtime param updates? I can run the md linter and validate the trace-hook example against the latest SDK.

maya: Main changes are: 1) heatmap JSON -> simplified CSV table for cost-per-token, 2) trace_hook example needs the new `trace_key` param name, 3) add quick note about batching effects on latency.

tara: @maya pinged — I noticed the trace-hook rename earlier. There are two SDK snippets (node + python) in the sample folder. I can update the node one if jen takes python.

jen: I can take python. Also will run the snippet through the sandbox to verify latency numbers. Which SLO sample should we show? p95 + avg? I vote p95 + avg.

own: Linter output: failing rule markdown/code-fence-lang in console/examples/heatmap.md and a broken link in the cost table anchor. I'll push a quick patch branch and drop the fixes into your PR if you want.

maya: Please do. Also add a 1-line note under "how to read this table" explaining that prefetching reduces tail latency but may increase unit cost — we want readers to see tradeoffs.

jen: Quick snippet (python) I'm planning to use — sanity check please:```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
resp = client.trace_hook(model=\"xgen-7b\", trace_key=\"session_id:123\", prefetch=True)
print(resp.metrics[\"p95_latency_ms\"], resp.metrics[\"cost_per_token_usd\"]) 
```

own: That looks fine; change `prefetch=True` -> `prefetch=\"windowed\"` to match the runtime enum. Also wrap print in f-string so readers see labels.

jen: Got it. I'll update and run.

maya: small editorial: can we avoid absolute numbers in the doc (they age quickly)? Use a sample table with relative deltas (baseline vs with-prefetch) + a note about environment.

own: Agreed. linter patch landed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4124 — includes the code-fence fixes and anchor. I added a TODO comment about the SDK param rename so the reviewers spot it.

tara: Merged my node snippet update into maya's branch, left one inline comment about using `trace_key` instead of `traceid`.

docs-bot: deploy-check: docs CI started for PR 4123 and PR 4124 — markdown-lint: running, snippet-sandbox: queued.

maya: thanks all. Action items: owen - ensure anchor link fix lands in 4123 (you said you'd add it), jen - update python snippet and run sandbox, tara - confirm node snippet shows same delta numbers, maya - replace absolute numbers with relative table and add one-liner tradeoff. I'll wait for CI green and then merge. :thumbsup:

own: will land anchor fix in 4123 today.

jen: sandbox run green locally, pushing snippet update in 30.

maya: perfect — keeping this thread pinned to the PR until merge. If CI flags anything, @here please drop a short note.
